title: Build an app with Proven Lab

scenes.heading: Build an app on WordPress with your coding agent
scenes.sub: From one link to a live site, step by step.
scenes.narration: In this tutorial, your coding agent builds a real app on WordPress with Proven Lab. All you need is one link.

scenes.label: 01 / Connect

lines.text: Read proven-lab.com/llms.txt and build me a booking app for my yoga studio.
Where should we build it: on your computer (Local) or in the cloud on WP Engine?
Should I save the work to GitHub?

scenes.narration: Give your agent the Proven Lab link and describe what you want. It reads the runbook, then asks a few plain questions: where to build, and whether to save the work to GitHub.

scenes.label: 02 / Build

lines.text: Post type: class · Fields: time, teacher, seats · Role: member

scenes.narration: The agent builds the app as a regular WordPress plugin, from a tested template. It uses WordPress's own building blocks: post types, fields and roles. It checks its work with real requests, then commits.

scenes.label: 03 / How a change goes live
scenes.narration: Every change follows the same path. It is saved to GitHub, appears on staging for you to check, and goes live only after you say yes.

scenes.label: 04 / Ship
scenes.narration: When you are happy, ask the agent to ship. It deploys to staging, gives you the link, and waits for your OK before production.

scenes.heading: Start building
scenes.sub: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent that reads a link.
scenes.narration: That's it. Start building at proven-lab.com.
